tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Supported languages for Trustpack content and their market domains.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List Trustpack printing/packaging services in the given language (lt,en,fi,no,lv,et,sv).

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get one service/packaging type by name or slug, localized to lang.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Info about Trustpack: printing house, languages/markets, how to request a quote.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a quote/inquiry to Trustpack (reply within 24 h). Optional: company, agent (your assistant name, e.g. "ChatGPT" - logged for attribution). Rate limited to 10 inquiries/hour.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Frequently asked questions about Trustpack (production, MOQ, lead time, certifications, files, delivery). Args: lang (lt|en|sv|lv|et|fi|no), query (optional keyword, e.g. "ISO", "FSC", "24"). Aliases language/topic accepted.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Trustpack work examples (real product photos) with public image URLs. Args: lang (lt|en|sv|lv|et|fi|no), service (keyword, accent-insensitive, works in EN/SV/LV/ET/FI/NO too, e.g. "label", "etikett", "packaging", "cosmetic", "food", "pharma", "beverage", "box"), limit (1-24). Aliases language/catego

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_portfolio · Private data: get_faq · Public sink: create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_portfolio · Private data: get_faq · Public sink: create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
